_comment: contractAddresses are keyed by network (selected by NETWORK_ID). Sending an ERC-20 transfer to the wrong network's token address is a silent-loss bug. USDC addresses are Circle's canonical Base deployments. KINETIX base_sepolia is null until its testnet address is confirmed — with a null address on the active network, transfers of that asset fail closed rather than going to a guessed address. VERIFY the KINETIX base_mainnet address against the live token at mainnet cutover.
